Confirmed fees 2026 to 2027: Extended producer responsibility for packaging
Waste disposal fees for 2026 to 2027 that will be charged to large producers obligated under extended producer responsibility (EPR) for packaging.

Extended producer responsibility for packaging : Confirmed fees 2026 to 2027
HTML
Details
Under EPR for packaging, obligated large producers who supply or import packaging in the UK are responsible for the costs of dealing with packaging waste.
This guidance sets out the 2026 to 2027 packaging waste disposal fees.
